metadata.title: Golden Hour Portrait with Framed Border

retrievalProfile.description: A centered outdoor portrait of a seated figure on stone steps, framed by a thick dark border with elegant top-aligned serif text.
triggerTerms: golden hour portrait on stone steps
framed album cover with top text

recipe.visualDefinition: A central photograph of a woman with curly hair sitting on blue-toned stone steps, wearing a light blouse and patterned skirt. The scene is lit by a warm sunset from the left, creating a strong glow against a dark, shadowed background. The entire image is contained within a thin white line, surrounded by a thick black outer frame featuring gold and white serif text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sunset light contrasting with cool blue stone steps
Centered subject framed by a thick dark border
Text aligned horizontally across the top margin
Triangular composition formed by the seated pose

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered vertically and horizontally within the inner frame, occupying approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright light source on the left tree.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down to the subject's face, follow the arms down to the boots, and rest on the texture of the steps.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial black border provides a heavy frame; dark foliage in the background creates depth.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow (sunset light and primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright sunset glow and the deep shadows of the border and background.

composition.position: Top left of the black border
Top right of the black border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-coded hierarchy using the same serif family with different weights and tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a woman with curly hair sitting on blue-grey stone steps at sunset. The light should hit from the left, creating a warm glow on the trees and the subject's side. Place this photo inside a thin white rectangular frame, surrounded by a thick black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two strings of text in a classic serif font at the top of the black border. The left string should be in golden yellow with wide tracking. The right string should be in white with even wider tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the subject centered on the steps?
Is there a clear distinction between the golden light and cool shadows?
Is the text placed entirely within the top black margin?
Is the thin white keyline present around the photo?

postGenerationChecks: Check for the golden-yellow color in the primary text
Ensure the steps have a blue-grey stone texture
Verify the 'framed' look with the black border
Confirm the wide letter spacing in the typography
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Portrait + Stone Steps + Golden Hour Light + Black Border Frame + Top-Aligned Spaced Serif
